output.claimText: The KAZ_S_159 operator completed mitigation of the 2026-06-05 detected methane plume, and a post-action measurement confirms the outcome by 2026-07-31.

output.verdict: Abstain — insufficient evidence to establish mitigation_confirmed for this claim and scope. This neither confirms nor disproves physical mitigation.
limitations: The supplied DEMO AUTHORED NOTE — PROJECT TEXT, NOT A PUBLISHER CLAIM says the source record reports feedback: Yes and notified: Yes, but supplies no action date, post-action measurement, measurement method, uncertainty, or follow-up reference for the 2026-06-05 plume.

The application shows source-level notified: Yes and feedback: Yes. It does not identify an intended recipient or exact notification time; these publisher metadata fields do not establish receipt, repair, or reduced emissions.

The in-scope 2026-07-11 plume observation is not linked to any documented action. The archive describes historical estimates, not continuous monitoring; a missing later observation cannot be treated as zero emissions.

One linked publisher report is metadata-only: its metadata and report body are withheld and the body was not included or assessed. The application says its item page reports an IMEO-confirmed methane mitigation action at Uzen Field in July 2026, but this is not an inspected action record or a post-action measurement tied to observationId 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd. Provider processing was not cleared.
No human assessment, human approval, or owner acceptance is evidenced. The owner role and due date below are proposed administrative routing only.
requestedEvidence: Next action: send a scoped records request to the KAZ_S_159 operator's site methane abatement/measurement records custodian for existing contemporaneous records tied to observation 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd. Request an attributable work order or closure record identifying the facility/asset and affected equipment, the specific action, exact action start and completion timestamps in UTC, the responsible record issuer, and completion/verification records with provenance.

Request the original dated post-action measurement record, if one exists after documented action completion and no later than 2026-07-31 UTC. It must identify the same site/asset, exact UTC timestamp, spatial coverage, measurement method and sensor, calibration and quality-control information, reported methane result and units, uncertainty, and detection threshold. Include the source document/data and provenance. If the result is a non-detection, provide actual coverage and detection limit; absence of a row is not a measurement.

Request an attributable follow-up reference and independent or otherwise authorized technical review that links the action and measurement to this same source/event, explains measurement comparability with the 2026-06-05 observation, and states what the result can support within its uncertainty and detection limits. If no qualifying measurement existed by 2026-07-31, record that gap; a later measurement cannot retroactively satisfy the claim's stated cutoff.
output.whyNeeded: The claim requires an attributable mitigation action and a measurement after that action by 2026-07-31. The supplied packet contains source metadata and historical plume estimates, but no exact action date or event-linked follow-up measurement. The 2026-07-11 observation is a later in-scope plume record (496 kg/h ± 226) with no established relationship to an action. The requested records are needed to assess the claim without inferring an outcome from notification, feedback, a publisher link, or missing observations.
acceptanceCriteria: An attributable operator record identifies KAZ_S_159, the relevant facility/asset and affected equipment, and explicitly links the action to plume observation 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd.
The action record states what work occurred, exact start/completion timestamps in UTC, its issuer/provenance, and documented completion or verification.

A dated post-action measurement exists after the documented completion and at or before 2026-07-31 UTC, covers the same relevant site/asset, and supplies method, sensor, calibration/QC, reported result with units, uncertainty, detection limit, coverage, and provenance.

An authorized technical reviewer can assess how the post-action result relates to the 2026-06-05 estimate using comparable scope/method and its uncertainty; a missing detection is not accepted as zero, and any physical outcome statement is limited to what the records support.
The report or excerpt is authorized for review and its source/provenance is attributable. The withheld linked report is not processed unless permission is established.
